record.body: R67 independence-weighted consumer capital is default-contained at ggen-marketplace@95387a0632f7e460e65cdd89e77ea7f902093af0. Newly reachable non-dominated edges: (1) execute R67 over returned R50/R61 consumer evidence and compute common-cause-discounted fanout; (2) select all consumers that add runtime/failure/authority/receipt/qualification orthogonality; (3) manufacture target-local adapters via canonical marketplace/ggen substrate and exact-head qualify/return receipts; (4) assimilate those receipts through R61 then R63/R65 to measure relief-to-qualified-manufacture Y; (5) compose independent consumers only after causal downstream unlock is observed. Historical PR #288 is superseded as implementation substrate but retained as provenance/option history. Correlated consumers remain lawful options, not independent multiplier evidence.
